description: This PHP source file handles duplicate record processing in the vtiger CRM system, including merging records, transferring related data, and rendering merge-related UI components.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: Smarty template engine class used for rendering UI components in vtiger CRM.

methods.name: transferRelatedRecords
methods.description: Transfers related records from one entity to another during record merge.

methods.name: DeleteEntity
methods.description: Deletes a specified entity record from the database.

methods.name: getParentTab
methods.description: Retrieves the parent tab identifier for the current module.

methods.name: isPermitted
methods.description: Checks user permissions for specific actions on records.

methods.name: getRecordValues
methods.description: Fetches record values for given record IDs.
